text: Which property does the overlap relation O(x,y) ≡ ∃z(P(z,x) ∧ P(z,y)) FAIL to have?
explanation: Overlap is reflexive (x is a common part of itself, by M1) and symmetric, but not transitive: the left half of a rod overlaps its middle third, the middle third overlaps the right half, yet the two halves are disjoint. So only transitivity fails.
